title: Code to Control: Synthesizing Parameterized Reactive Controllers
abstract: arXiv:2609.38733v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recent LLM-based approaches to control either invoke a language model to select actions or synthesize world models that require planning at every decision, introducing latency that can limit real-time use. We introduce Code to Control, an approach that synthesizes Python controllers which execute directly as policies. Code to Control separates program structure from parameters. An LLM synthesizes the controller structure, while derivative-free search fits its parameters for continuous control using feedback from the environment. Once learned, the resulting controllers require neither LLM inference nor planning at decision time, enabling real-time gameplay and, under our timing protocol, faster action selection than a PPO policy. Across a suite of Atari games, Flappy Bird, and MuJoCo tasks, Code to Control outperforms planning-based program synthesis methods, remains competitive with deep reinforcement learning while using fewer environme

translated_title: 代码到控制：合成参数化反应式控制器
translated_abstract: 近年来基于大语言模型（LLM）的控制方法要么调用语言模型来选择动作，要么合成需要在每次决策时进行规划的世界模型，由此引入的延迟可能限制其实时应用。我们提出 Code to Control，一种合成可直接作为策略执行的 Python 控制器的方法。该方法将程序结构与参数分离：由大语言模型合成控制器结构，再通过无导数搜索利用环境反馈为连续控制拟合参数。学习完成后，所得控制器在决策时既不需要大语言模型推理，也不需要规划，从而实现实时游戏操控，并且在我们的计时协议下，其动作选择速度快于 PPO 策略。在一系列 Atari 游戏、Flappy Bird 和 MuJoCo 任务上，Code to Control 的表现优于基于规划的程序合成方法，并在使用更少环境交互样本的情况下与深度强化学习保持竞争力。
tldr: Code to Control 将控制器结构（由大语言模型合成）与参数（由无导数搜索拟合）分离，生成可直接执行的 Python 控制器，在决策时无需 LLM 推理或规划即可实现实时控制，性能超越基于规划的程序合成方法并与深度强化学习相当。
en_tdlr: Code to Control separates controller structure (synthesized by an LLM) from parameters (fitted by derivative-free search), producing directly executable Python controllers that enable real-time control without LLM inference or planning at decision time, outperforming planning-based program synthesis while remaining competitive with deep reinforcement learning.
